LanguageData.SSC_PetDogTame.label: directed taming
LanguageData.SSC_PetDogTame.description: A final Pet Dog can select a living, conscious animal on the same map that has no mental state and is factionless or belongs to the player. The caster walks into its cell for 2 seconds of guidance while the target pauses, with a progress bar, training bubble and repeated speech waves. Normal sleepers can be awakened; downed animals with sufficient consciousness are also eligible. Dryads are excluded. Factionless animals must meet the vanilla taming conditions and are directly tamed into the player faction on completion. Owned animals must have an enabled training project that meets vanilla prerequisites and species/body-size requirements and still needs training. On completion, one eligible project is selected by vanilla priority and filled completely, including previously learned training that has decayed. The animal's master is unchanged. No food, extra materials or success roll is required, and the normal training interval does not apply. Both outcomes share a 1 in-game day cooldown; cancellation, an invalid target or no eligible training project starts no new cooldown. Available while drafted and undrafted. Grants no Animals skill or specialization experience and triggers no post-work events.
